events.title: Winter Recess for Public Schools
events.description: NYC public schools are closed for Winter Recess between December 24th and January 1st. Students return to school on Monday, January 4th.

events.title: Midwinter Recess
events.description: NYC public schools are closed from 2\/15- 2\/19.

events.title: Presidents Day - Washington's Birthday
events.description: Federal, State, & City Holiday. Post offices are closed. NYC public schools are closed for Midwinter Recess.

events.title: Eid al-Fitr
events.description: NYC public schools are closed.

events.title: Daylight Saving Time Begins
events.description: On March 14, 2027, clocks are set ahead one hour at 2:00 am local standard time (which becomes 3:00 am local daylight time).

events.title: Spring Recess - NYC Public Schools Closed
events.description: NYC Public schools are closed for Spring Recess from 4\/22- 4\/30

events.title: Anniversary Day
events.description: Anniversary Day. Chancellor's Conference Day for staff development. In all five boroughs, students do not attend.

events.title: Juneteenth Observed
events.description: Federal Holiday, State Holiday, City Holiday; New York City public schools are open. Post offices and other government buildings are closed.

events.title: Last Day of School Year - NYC Public Schools
events.description: This is the last day for all public school students.
